name: daily-plan
description: Make a concise daily plan from known events and unfinished tasks.

# Daily planning

Read `.github/routine-guidance.md` and follow it. Review today's known events and unfinished canonical tasks, including known deadlines and dependencies. Highlight the most time-sensitive commitments and suggest a realistic first step; do not assign invented times or change task status. If the calendar or task information is incomplete, say so. Give one primary next action and allow the user to defer or skip.
